sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the concept of a 'Smart Home' in the context of basic home automation projects. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A smart home uses interconnected internet-enabled devices and sensors to automatically manage lighting, security, and climate, offering enhanced convenience, energy efficiency, and remote control for residents.

questions.question_text: What is the practical function of identifying a 'target audience' before designing an advertisement? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The target audience identifies the specific demographic group most likely to buy the product, ensuring the advertisement's tone, visuals, and placement effectively appeal to those exact consumers.

questions.question_text: Explain the core role of an exhibition committee during the planning phase of a school Kaushal Mela. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The exhibition committee is responsible for coordinating stall layouts, managing logistics, allocating resources, and ensuring all participating students have the necessary materials to display their vocational projects safely.

questions.question_text: Suppose your student team is selected to organize a project demonstration stall at the upcoming school Kaushal Mela. Outline the key preparatory steps you will take to ensure a successful and engaging public exhibition. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, we will conceptualize a clear theme for our vocational project and prepare an engaging working model. Next, we will design informative charts and banners to explain the mechanics. Finally, we will assign specific speaking roles to team members to confidently interact with visitors and answer queries.
